original.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 replaces SPDY with WebSocket as the protocol for portforward and pod exec operations.

corrected.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 uses websocket instead of spdy for portforward and pod exec.

decision.reason: [ev-44a03a4444c2] says Argo CD "replace[s] spdy with websocket for portforward and pod exec", so the subject is a protocol behaviour and the change type is behavior-changed. Two parts need fixing. The proposed name adds "protocol", which is not in the evidence; the free-form name should use only the evidence's own words, so it becomes "portforward-pod-exec". The before/after literals should match the text exactly as "spdy" and "websocket", not the recapitalised "SPDY"/"WebSocket".
